resolution.description: mypy resolves what its types reach; anything else carries an unresolved reason

dispatch.description: a method call names the method the receiver's static type finds; one a workspace subclass overrides, or a workspace protocol's, is unresolved, as is a `super()` call any workspace subclass's MRO would send elsewhere

types.description: mypy's inferred types; a node with none is `Any`, and a global that can only hold one function has that function's type

integer-semantics.description: Python integers are unbounded and signed

mutability.description: a binding is mutable when this function writes it again or a `nonlocal` can; what it holds can change regardless

aliasing.description: places record assignments to names, attributes and subscripts; a method that mutates its receiver and what two names share are not tracked

implicit-calls.description: operators, subscripts, comparisons, truth tests, unpacking, properties, descriptors, `__getattribute__` and `__getattr__` appear as calls or overloaded references; iteration protocols, context managers, `__format__` and what a store or `del` runs do not

evaluation-order.description: follows Python's order, with a generator expression's body in place rather than where it is consumed

exceptional-flow.description: `raise`, `assert` and calls inside a `try` have edges; other expressions that can raise do not

macro-provenance.description: a comprehension's loops are marked as desugared, and so are module and class bodies, from the construct `module` or `type`; decorators are not treated as macros

unit.description: one unit per module; imports are recorded without their targets

method.description: functions and methods, and what module and class bodies run, as bodies

ast.description: every statement, with constructs lacking a neutral kind as registered py: extensions

cfg.description: edges between a function's own nodes; a lambda's body has none

symbol.description: CPython's symtable decides each name's scope

type.description: mypy's types, with unions and type variables opaque

place.description: writes only; reads and arguments have no places
